components.description: Renders its children only when the access provider allows `action` on `resource`, else its `fallback` slot (nothing while checking). With `resultPath` it also writes `{ can, reason, loading }` to state: bind a button's `disabled` or any element's `visible` to it to disable or hide it.

Read data on mount and parameter changes, and again when a live provider pushes a change to the resource (`liveMode`). Projects { data, total, loading, error } to resultPath. Bind display props to that state path.

Connects a conversation to an agent endpoint that answers with an AI SDK UI message stream (SSE). Projects `{ id, messages, status, error, streaming }` to statePath: bind ChatThread `messages` and PromptInput `streaming` to it, send with `agentSend`, stop with `agentStop`, and pass ChatThread events to `agentEvent` (approve, reject, answer, skip, regenerate, edit, suggestion). With `resource` the conversation named by `sessionId` loads through the DataProvider and the resource refreshes after each reply.

A placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading. `text` draws `lines` of natural widths, `circle` an avatar, `rect` a card or image, and `list-row` an avatar with two text lines per row. Shimmers unless the reader prefers reduced motion; `label` names the loading region.
An indeterminate activity indicator for a pending action or a small area. Sizes match the icon scale; `label` is spoken, and shown beside it with `showLabel`.
A section that is loading: a spinner and text centred in the area the content will fill. Use Skeleton when the content shape is known.

An empty state: a glyph on a soft tint, a title saying why the area is empty and a description of what to do next, centred in the space the content would fill. Children (usually one Button) sit below as the way forward.
A keyboard shortcut as key chips: one key or a combination such as `["⌘", "K"]`. Modifier symbols are spoken by name.
Scrolls its children inside a fixed or maximum height with slim themed scrollbars, vertically, horizontally or both. The viewport takes keyboard focus; give `ariaLabel` to name it.

A compact label for a category, person or filter, in the Badge tones and appearances. `closable` adds a remove button that emits `close`. `checkable` turns it into a toggle chip: bind `checked` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }); pressing flips it and emits `change`.

A row of tags bound to an array. Without `options` each value is a closable tag and removing one updates `value`. With `options` the tags are selectable chips that toggle their value in `value` (one at most with `multiple: false`).

An inline month calendar bound to state. `mode` picks one date, a `[start, end]` range or several dates (all `yyyy-MM-dd`). `min`/`max`, `disabledDates` and `disabledWeekdays` block days; `marks` put tone dots under days with events. The month caption switches to month and year grids unless `captionLayout` is `label`.
An always-open list of options with icons, descriptions and group headings. Picks one value, or an array with `multiple`. Arrow keys, Home/End and type-ahead move; Space or Enter picks.

components.description: Picks a number, or a `[start, end]` range with `range`, by dragging along a track. Supports `step`, labelled `marks`, a value tooltip, number inputs beside the track and a vertical orientation. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End move the focused thumb.

Picks one option shown as a card with an icon, title, description and optional badge or trailing text (a price). Arrow keys move between cards. Suits plans, shipping methods and other choices that need explaining.
Picks several options shown as cards with an icon, title, description and optional badge or trailing text. The value is an array of option values.
A compact row of checkable tags for filters: one value, or several with `multiple`. Chosen tags are filled like filter chips.

components.description: A score as a row of stars or another icon, with optional half steps. `readonly` turns it into a display. Arrow keys change the value; Home and End jump to the ends.
Picks a color as a `#rrggbb` hex string from a saturation/brightness area and hue strip, preset swatches, a hex field or, where the browser has one, the eyedropper. Empty is the empty string.

Picks a color from an inline row of swatches, a radio group: arrow keys move and select, the chosen swatch shows a check and a ring in its own color. The value is a `#rrggbb` hex string; empty is the empty string. `clearable` adds a "no color" swatch and `allowCustom` a + tile that opens the full ColorPicker panel. Use it for a short palette such as tag or theme colors; use ColorPicker for any color in a compact field.
A one-time code in separate boxes. Typing advances, Backspace steps back, arrows move and a pasted code fills every box. Emits `complete` once all boxes are filled.
Draws a signature with a pointer, pen or finger. The value is a PNG data URL, empty when cleared; Undo removes the last stroke. The pad takes its container's width.
Picks a HugeIcons icon by name (e.g. `delivery-truck-01`) from a searchable grid. The icon set loads on first open. The value is the name an Icon or Button `icon` accepts.

The message box of a chat: a text area that grows with its text, chips for attachments and @-referenced context (each removable), an optional compact model picker and a send button. Enter emits `submit`, Shift+Enter adds a line. With `mentions`, typing @ (or the @ button) opens the reference picker and a pick lands in `context`; with `commands`, typing / at the start offers them, and one without a `prompt` writes `command` and emits `command`. While `streaming` the send button turns into a stop button that emits `stop`. Bind `value`, `attachments`, `context` and `model` with `$bindState`; clear the text after sending with pushState `clearStatePath`. A suggestion fills the box and emits `suggestion`.

One message of a conversation, drawn from the agent message contract. A user message is a bubble with its files and context chips; an assistant message renders its parts in order — Markdown text with a caret while streaming, consecutive thinking and tool calls gathered under one activity line that shimmers while working and folds once done, plans, diffs, approvals and questions — then a sources line whose citations preview on hover or focus, then copy, regenerate and rating actions and follow-up suggestions. Bind `feedback` to keep the rating; `activeEvent` receives what was pressed before the matching event.
The actions under an answer: copy, regenerate, and thumbs up or down as toggle buttons. Bind `feedback` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }); pressing the active rating again clears it.

A compact working pill — spinner, phase label and elapsed time — that settles to a check with the time taken when `state` is `done`. Steps and reasoning text fold out beneath it: open while working, folded once done. No motion beyond the spinner, which stops for readers who prefer reduced motion.

A tool or action the agent called, as one quiet timeline row: its icon (a spinner while running), its name and a one-line `summary` of what it found, with the time it took. When there is input, output or an error the row folds open to show them as highlighted JSON or the error text. Inside a ChatMessage consecutive thinking and tool calls gather under one activity line.

Asks the reader to confirm before a registered action runs: what it does in plain words (`action` names it for the host and is not shown), then what it covers — a checklist of affected `items`, product `lines` with images and amounts, label and value `fields` (address, delivery, refund destination) and a `total` — and Approve, Reject and (with `editable`) Edit. Bind `status` and `selected`: Approve writes `approved` and emits `approve`, Reject writes `rejected` and emits `reject`; run the action from `on.approve`. To wait for the action, set `status` to `running` (the buttons lock and Approve shows progress), then `approved`, or `failed` with a `reason` to keep the card open for another try. `tone` marks risky changes, and `danger` turns Approve red. Once approved, rejected or expired the card folds to one line with the decision and `reason`, which opens to show what was decided.

A question the agent asks before it goes on. `single` (default) lists the options to pick one — pressing an option answers at once, and digit keys pick by number — `multiple` lets the reader tick several and confirm, `text` takes a written answer; `allowText` adds a written answer beside the options. Bind `status` and `answer`: answering writes `answered` and the value and emits `answer`, Skip (with `skippable`) writes `skipped` and emits `skip`. Answered and skipped questions fold to one line with the answer, which opens to change it.

The steps an agent intends to take, in order, each `pending`, `running`, `done`, `failed` or `skipped` with an optional detail line, on a timeline under a summary line with the progress such as 3/5. The running step shimmers; the list folds from the summary line.

What a change does. `fields` lists record edits as label, before and after, marked added, removed or changed. `before` and `after` compare two texts line by line — a Spec or a config — with added and removed lines highlighted in the CodeBlock style and a +/− count.

What the agent can see: a "Viewing" chip for the current page with a share switch bound to `shared`, the attached context items (removable, which updates a bound `items`), and an optional usage meter of `used` out of `limit`.

The @ reference picker: a search field, a tab per kind of thing (`types`, e.g. orders, articles, customers), and the results with the match highlighted, picked with the arrow keys and Enter. Picks are written to `value` as context items `{ id, label, kind, icon }`; bind it to the PromptInput `context` so they show as chips. Static `options` are filtered here by `type` and `query`; with a remote source the host searches and pages them (`loading`, `hasMore`).

A list of conversations. Each row keeps a dot slot before its title for its status (`running` pulses, `waiting` for the reader, `unread` reply, `error`), so titles stay aligned whether or not a dot shows. `compact` is one line per session; `detailed` adds the time and the last line. `group` starts a heading such as `Today`. Pressing a row writes its id to a bound `value` and emits `change`; `searchable` adds a search field and `creatable` a New chat button.

A conversation drawn from an array of agent messages (`{ id, role, parts, status? }`), each as a ChatMessage. Bind `messages` with `$bindState` and the thread keeps ratings, approval decisions and answers to questions in it; `activeEvent` receives `{ type, messageId, partId?, value? }` before each event, so `on.approve` can run the registered action the approval names.
Groups children without a surface. `stack` stacks them, `split` puts the last child in an aside. For general layout use Stack and Grid.
Triggers an action. Solid, outline, ghost and brand appearances, with loading and disabled states.
Single-line text entry bound to state. Supports prefix, suffix and a clear button.
Multi-line text entry; `autoResize` grows it with its content.
Markdown text entry with a formatting toolbar. The value stays plain Markdown.
Numeric entry with `min`, `max` and `step`. The value is a number or null.

Picks one option from a list, with optional search and clear. Options may show an avatar or image and a description line; with `hasMore` set, scrolling the list to its end emits `loadMore`, where a page appends the next options (connected Admin selects load them themselves).

Picks several options from a list. The value is an array of option values. Options may show an avatar or image and a description line; with `hasMore` set, scrolling the list to its end emits `loadMore`, where a page appends the next options (connected Admin selects load them themselves).
A single on or off choice with a label.
Picks several options, all visible at once. Suits short lists.
Picks one option, all visible at once. Suits short lists.
Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.
Date as `yyyy-MM-dd`. Opens on the selected month; `min`/`max` bound the days. The month caption switches to month and year grids; `captionLayout: "label"` keeps it plain.

Hierarchical choice, one column per level (region → city, category → subcategory). The value is the path of option values from the root. `changeOnSelect` lets a parent be chosen; `searchable` finds a path by any label.
Time of day as `HH:mm` (`HH:mm:ss` with `seconds`). Hour and minute columns; `step` spaces the minutes, `min`/`max` bound the choice.

Date and time as a local `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm` string, the `datetime-local` format. A calendar beside time columns; `min`/`max` bound the days. The month caption switches to month and year grids; `captionLayout: "label"` keeps it plain.

Date range as `[start, end]` (`yyyy-MM-dd`), the same shape as a dateRange filter. Two months side by side; optional `presets` jump to a fixed range. A month caption switches to month and year grids; `captionLayout: "label"` keeps it plain.

Groups fields, runs their `checks` and emits `submit` when they pass. In a JSON page the values live in page state, bound on each field, and business rules go to the `submitForm` action; `value`, `defaultValue` and `rules` here are for React hosts that submit the form themselves.
One labelled field: chooses a control from `fieldType` or `widget`, and shows help and errors.

Rows and columns with sorting, selection and cell kinds such as badge, tags and currency. `rowActions` elements render in each row of the `kind: "actions"` column with their own `on`; props read the row via `$item`, params via the bound `activeRow`. Otherwise the column's `actions` menu emits `rowAction`. `highlightField` tints rows whose field is truthy. While rows are selected, `bulkActions` show a selection bar; `bulkAction` binds the pressed value to `activeAction`.

Label/value pairs. `grid` fills responsive columns with the label above the value; `rows` puts the label beside the value for narrow panels. A `span: "full"` item takes the whole row and wraps long text such as an address or note. `bordered` draws one rounded frame around the list with hairlines between the rows, for an order summary or a confirmation.

Moves through pages of a list, with an optional total and page-size choice. `pages` (default) numbers the pages, as in `1 2 3 … 10`, keeping the first, the last and the neighbours of the current page; `simple` shows the position as `3 / 12` between the arrows, for narrow places and lists walked one page at a time. The page size uses the Select list.

A modal panel for a focused task or a confirmation; its width follows the content within the size range. Lead-in text belongs in description, which sits under the title in the header, not as the first child. Without children it is a compact confirmation sized to its title and description, led by a tone icon unless icon is false.
A side panel that keeps the page in view, for details and edit forms.
Surface with an optional title, description and header icon. `href` turns the whole card into a link, e.g. a shortcut tile.
Switches between sibling views in one place.
Sends files with progress, cancel and retry. The upload itself comes from a host service.
A short status or count label in a semantic tone. The `brand` tone marks brand-coloured emphasis: soft is a brand tint with brand text, solid is the brand ground.
A short hint shown on hover and keyboard focus of its single child, such as an icon button. Put the full name in the child; the tooltip only adds a hint.

A button that opens a list of commands. Picking one writes its key to the bound `value` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }) and emits `select`; bind `on.select` to the action that handles it. A circle or square shape with an icon shows the icon only and uses the label as its name.
Sections that fold open: one at a time by default, or several with `multiple`. `defaultOpen` lists the keys open on first render.

A floating panel anchored to a trigger: a title, a description, any body (`children`) and optional footer actions. The trigger is the `trigger` slot (any element, e.g. a Button or an Avatar) or, without it, a button built from `label`/`icon`/`appearance`/`size`/`shape`. Bind `open` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }) to open or close it from actions; `confirmText`/`cancelText` add footer buttons that emit `confirm`/`cancel` and close the panel. `width`: sm 16rem, md 18rem (default), lg 24rem.

Asks "are you sure?" in a small bubble beside a destructive inline action, without a modal. Wrap the action (`children`, e.g. a Button) or build a button from `label`/`icon`/`appearance`. Confirming emits `confirm` (chain the real action there), cancelling, Escape or clicking away emit `cancel`. `tone` (default `danger`) colours the icon and the confirm button. Focus moves to Cancel and returns to the trigger.

An image in a fixed `aspectRatio` frame (default 4/3; `auto` keeps its own) with a loading shimmer and an image-off fallback when it fails. `radius` follows the theme (md by default). `preview` makes it a button that opens the full-screen Lightbox. `width` caps it in px; `caption` prints below and labels the preview.

Another web page in a sandboxed frame. `src` must be https or a path on this site, and one of `LumiEmbedProvider` origins when set (Admin `frameOrigins`); otherwise a notice shows. Lumi passes the frame no sign-in token; a page on this site still shares the storage and cookies of this site, as any same-site page does, so frame only same-site pages you serve yourself. `height` in px (480) or `fill`, or `aspectRatio`.

A full-screen image viewer with zoom (buttons, wheel, double-click; drag to pan), previous/next, a counter and a caption. Keyboard: Escape closes, ←/→ step, +/− zoom, 0 resets. Bind `open` and `index` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }) and open it from a Button action; `change` fires when the image changes. Image and ImageGrid open it themselves.

Slides on a scroll-snap track with previous/next buttons and dots. Slides are `items` (images with an optional title and description over them) or the children, one slide each. `perView` shows several at once. `autoplay` advances every `interval` ms (default 5000), pauses on hover and focus, offers a pause button and stays off under reduced motion. Bind `value` to the current slide index; `change` fires when it moves.

The path to the current page; the last item is the current page. An item with `href` is a link; one without writes its key to the bound `value` ({ "$bindState": "/path" }) and emits `select`, so an action decides where to go. Past `maxItems` (default 4) the middle items fold into an overflow menu.
A message inside the page in a semantic tone, optionally closable.

An icon by name: a Lumi name such as `search` or any HugeIcons free icon such as `delivery-truck-01` (or `DeliveryTruck01Icon`); names outside the bundled set load on first use. Give `label` when the icon carries meaning on its own.
Progress bar, compatible with the json-render shadcn Progress. `value` runs from 0 to `max` (default 100); `label` is shown above the bar and names it.
Flex container for layouts, compatible with the json-render shadcn Stack. Vertical by default; `wrap` lets a horizontal row of buttons, badges or links wrap.

Grid layout (1-6 columns), compatible with the json-render shadcn Grid; drops columns as its own width shrinks (each column stays at least 12rem), so it also works inside drawers, cards and embedded previews. `minColumnWidth` (px) instead fits as many columns as the width allows. `align: "stretch"` gives the items of a row one height, as for a row of cards.
Visual separator line.
Heading text (h1-h4). Inside an Admin page the page header already provides the h1; sections usually use h2 or h3.

Paragraph text at a readable measure, compatible with the json-render shadcn Text. `muted` for secondary copy, `caption` for small print, `lead` for an intro, `code` for inline code. Line breaks in `text` are kept.

A person or account: image or initials on a tint picked from the name, with no outline. `sm`/`md`/`lg` match the control heights; `xl` leads a profile header. `showName` adds the name and an optional description beside it.
A stack of overlapping avatars for the people on a record. Beyond `max`, the rest collapse into a "+N" avatar.

Read-only source with syntax highlighting for JSON, JavaScript/TypeScript (JSX/TSX), CSS, HTML, Bash, Go, YAML, SQL and Markdown; other languages show as plain text. Plain text renders first and the highlighting fills in without moving anything. `title` adds a header bar, `files` shows several files as tabs, and the copy button copies the current file. `showLineNumbers`, `highlightLines`, `wrap` and `maxHeight` shape the code area, which scrolls inside a keyboard-reachable region; `collapsible` folds it behind its title.

Edits source code with the same highlighting as CodeBlock, line numbers, bracket matching, auto-indent and undo. The value is the text; bind it with `$bindState` like any input. Tab indents; press Escape, then Tab, to move focus on. `checkSyntax` reports JSON syntax errors. The editor loads on first use, behind a plain text field of the same size.

Typesets long-form content: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, images and rules share one reading rhythm. Wrap Heading and Text children in it, or use Markdown and Html, which render inside the same styles. `size` sets the body size; the width follows the container.

Renders Markdown as typeset content in the Prose styles: headings, paragraphs, ordered, unordered and task lists, quotes, fenced code with highlighting, tables, rules, links, emphasis and images (`![alt](src "caption")`; alone on a line it becomes a captioned figure). Raw HTML in the source stays text, and only http(s), mailto, tel and relative links or http(s) and relative images are drawn. Headings get ids from their text unless `anchors` is false.

Renders an HTML fragment, such as an article body saved by a rich-text editor, as typeset content in the Prose styles. The markup is sanitized first: scripts, event handlers, inline styles, forms, frames and unsafe URLs are removed, ids are prefixed so they cannot clash with the page, and external links open in a new tab without access to the opener. The sanitizer loads on first use; until then the block is empty.
A generic box for padding, surface and border when no other layout fits.
Controlled list filters with optional advanced conditions.
Shows progress through ordered steps, optionally clickable.
Text tags as removable chips. Enter adds the typed tag, Backspace in the empty input removes the last. Bind `value` as a string array, or use it through FormField with `widget: "TagsInput"`.
Free text entry that suggests matching options as you type, with the matched part highlighted. Arrow keys move through suggestions, Enter takes one. The value is the text.
Multi-line text where typing the trigger (`@` by default) opens a suggestion list at the caret; choosing one inserts the mention. The value stays plain text.
Two lists, available and chosen, each with search, check-all and counts; the arrow buttons move checked items across. The value is the array of chosen option values.

Image tiles over a bound `{ url, thumbnail?, alt? }[]` value; the first tile is the cover. The upload tile and a file drop take images, checked against `accept`, `maxSize` and `max`; each file shows its progress with cancel, and a failure stays as a tile with retry. Drag a tile, or press Space and the arrow keys, to reorder; Set as cover moves one to the front. The upload itself comes from a host service; without one the chosen files stay local previews.

Repeatable rows over a bound array (order lines, contacts) as an editable table or cards, with add, duplicate, remove, reordering by the drag handle (or its arrow keys), min/max, computed columns, footer totals and per-cell errors. Put native `repeat: { statePath, key }` on the Repeater and one `RepeaterRow` child whose children bind cells with `$bindItem`.
The row template inside a Repeater's `repeat`. Its children are the editable cells, one per non-computed column, in column order.

Events in order on one continuous rule, each with a time, a status and optional detail under the title. The time sits at the end of the title's line (`datePlacement: "below"` stacks it under the title). Status markers: complete is a success dot, current a brand ring, upcoming a hollow ring. `marker: "dot"` draws an activity feed: a dot per item in its tone.

Who did what, newest first: an avatar, one sentence with the actor and target in strong text (`actor action target`), a second line with context and an optional status badge, and the time at the end of the first line. Use Timeline for a sequence of states.

Hierarchical list that expands and collapses. `selectionMode` picks one or several nodes; `checkable` adds tri-state checkboxes and binds the checked values (`checkStrategy`: every node, leaves only or topmost parents). `searchable` filters by label, highlights matches and opens their ancestors. Nodes without `children` load on demand when the host connects a source. Bind `expandedValue` to keep the open nodes in state.

components.description: A select whose panel is a Tree. Single by default; `multiple` or `checkable` binds an array and shows the first picks as tags. `showPath` writes the full path in the trigger; `searchable` filters the tree inside the panel.

components.description: The Cascader columns shown inline, without a trigger. The value is the path of option values; `multiple` checks leaves across branches and binds an array of paths.
Dashboard metrics and content panels.
Record summary, content and activity.
Bound settings navigation. Default children can use visible to select section content.

One settings card bound to a record. `auto` (default) saves each change through submitForm: choices on change, typed fields on blur or Enter, invalid values stay unsent. `manual` adds Discard and Save for changes that need confirmation. Bind fields to paths under valuesPath.
Controlled Admin results grid with pagination. `rowActions` works as on Table. `bulkActions` show a selection bar over the grid; `bulkAction` binds the pressed value to `activeAction`.
Admin filter toolbar. Bind value to query filters.
Accessible recoverable Admin page state.
Admin page surface. `stack` spaces several sections (cards, grids, tables) with the standard section gap.
Admin page heading and action slots.
Admin page frame with composition slots.

A documented example card: the live result of its children, and a Code view that shows them as a native Spec. `id` names the card for in-page links (`#id`) and must be unique on the page. The Code view reads the page Spec, so it appears on pages rendered by LumiSpecPage or under LumiSpecSource.

A full-page conversation with an agent endpoint that answers with an AI SDK UI message stream: the conversations, the thread and the composer over one Lumi agent session. The conversations come from the DataProvider `resource` (default `agent-sessions`): its list fills the session list, `getOne` loads a conversation, and it refreshes after each reply. The open conversation is the `param` query parameter (default `session`), so it survives a reload. In the dual layout the conversations take the shell's second column in place of the module menu; elsewhere the page shows them in a column of its own. Use it as the page root.

Data-backed Admin list with pagination and sorting in the native page Store. `actions` holds page controls; `toolbar` sits between the header and the results, for a FilterBar whose bound value the `filters` of the list read; `rowActions` works as on Table. With `syncWithLocation` page, page size and sort also live in the address query (`page`, `pageSize`, `sort=field:asc`), so reloads, shared links and back/forward restore them. `bulkActions` show a selection bar over the results; `bulkAction` binds the pressed value to `activeAction` beside the bound `selectedKeys`.
Admin form with business validation, dirty guards and one native value path.
Dashboard panel: one surface with a title, an optional header action and footer line.
A headline figure with unit, change chip and optional sparkline.
Totals for the table below, from the same query snapshot as its rows.
Dot-matrix trend for a daily series, with an accessible list of values.

Column chart for a handful of categories or days, on dashed gridlines with a value axis and a hover reading. The `highlight` column (the peak by default) is drawn in the full tone and the rest in a tint; `showValues` prints each reading above its column.

Ranking of items by value: label, reading and an optional share of the total over a thin bar measured against the largest item. Sorted descending by default; an `other` item stays last in a neutral tone. `valueTone: "muted"` sets the reading back as a secondary count.

Centred conversion funnel: ordered stages as tapering bands joined by trapezoid connectors, stepping down one palette colour. Each stage shows its count and share of the first; each connector shows the conversion from the stage above, with the drop-off in the hover reading.

Compact record rows for a feed, drawer or dashboard side panel: identity, status and a figure, with metadata below. `checked` adds a leading checkbox (a to-do list); `progress` adds a bar under the title. Bind `items` to Query data; use Table for sortable or paginated records.

A readable article: tags, title, standfirst, author with date and reading time, an optional cover figure, then the body in the Prose styles from Markdown or sanitized HTML. On wide screens a contents list of the body's h2 and h3 headings follows the reading position beside it. `actions` sits beside the byline (edit, share); `default` follows the body, for related records or comments.
Where work piles up across ordered stages: one population split in a single bar, e.g. orders by status. Use FunnelChart when each stage is a subset of the one before.
A small set of exclusive views of the same data; bind value with $bindState.

Specifications (e.g. Color, Size) as tag inputs, with every combination generated below as a matrix row. `columns` sets what each row edits (number, currency, text or select; default price, stock and code) and `labels` renames the chrome, e.g. to models or bundles. Changing specifications keeps values for combinations that remain; a button beside a column header copies the value of the first row to every row (numeric and select columns by default, `fill` per column).

Columns of cards moved by drag and drop or from the keyboard (Space, arrows, Space). Each card names its column in `columnField` (default `status`). On `move` the bound `move` holds `{ id, from, to, index, rank }`; persist `to` and `rank` with `update`. Feed `value` from Query data or bind it with $bindState; `add` writes the column to `activeColumn`, `cardClick` writes the card id to `activeCard`.

Month and week calendar of dated events as tone chips; extra events in a month cell fold into a "+N more" menu. Bind `view` and `date` with $bindState to drive a Query for the visible range. `dayClick` writes `YYYY-MM-DD` to `activeDate`; `eventClick` writes the event id to `activeEvent`. Weekday names and the first day of the week follow the locale.

Side panel tree that narrows a list to one branch, placed in the ListPage `aside` slot. Bind `value` to the state path a ListPage filter reads (`eq`), or bind `subtree` for the chosen node and its loaded descendants (`in`). `null` means every record. Nodes come from static `items` or a `source` resource.

Tells the Shell's assistant what this page is about while the page is open: each item becomes a context chip the reader can remove before sending, and leaves when the page closes or the items change. Renders nothing; place it anywhere in the page.

Another JSON page in place of this element, for a block several pages share. It loads when first shown and is cached by src; its state is its own, with params at /include/params, and it starts afresh when params change. A page that includes itself, directly or further down, or includes nested deeper than 8, shows an error.

The change history of a resource or one record from the app's audit log provider, as an activity feed: who created, updated (with the fields), deleted or imported what, and when. It refreshes after every write to the resource. Place it in a DetailPage or a DashboardCard.

Form field whose value is one record key (or, with `multiple`, a list of keys) picked from a searchable, paged table in a dialog. Chosen keys show as tags; preselected keys are read by ID so their labels show. `searchField` adds a search box filtering with `like`.
Accessible chart with an optional, lazily loaded rendering engine and data table fallback.
